description: Eval prompts for the sac-excel-addin skill. Each case lists facts a correct answer must contain (expectations) and claims it must not make (must_not). Facts were checked against SAP Help and SAP Note 3594453 on 2026-10-29.

evals.prompt: Convert this Analysis for Office formula to the SAP Analytics Cloud Excel add-in: =SAPGetData("DS_1";"Net Sales";"0COUNTRY=DE;0MATERIAL=M-01")
expectations: Uses SAP.GETDATA with dimension/member pairs as separate arguments
Treats the measure as a pair with the measure/account dimension ID, not as its own argument
Recommends member and dimension IDs instead of texts
Warns that dimensions not specified fall back to the panel filter, then the backend default
Mentions refreshing functions after filter changes (Refresh Sheet Functions / Refresh Selected Functions)
must_not: Keeps the AO 'Dim=Member;Dim=Member' string syntax inside SAP.GETDATA
Claims SAP.GETDATA only returns values visible in a table's navigation state

evals.prompt: Our AO workbooks run VBA that calls SAPSetVariable and SAPSetFilter before refreshing. Can we move them to the SAC Excel add-in?
expectations: Mentions the VBA bridge SAPOFXLA.xlam from SAP Note 3594453 (Excel desktop only)
States the SAC add-in VBA API has no method to set filter or variable values programmatically; only dialogs (ShowPromptsForWorkbook/ShowPromptsForDataSources/SelectDimensionFilter)
Suggests a redesign, e.g. cell-driven SAP.OVERWRITEDIMENSIONFILTER plus RefreshTable/RefreshAll
must_not: Claims the SAC add-in supports no VBA at all
Invents SAC VBA methods such as SetFilter or SetVariable

evals.prompt: We plan on BPC and use BW-IP planning sequences from Analysis for Office. Should we switch to the SAC add-in?
expectations: States BPC is not a supported data source for the SAC add-in
States BW-IP planning functions/sequences have no SAC add-in equivalent; SAC uses data action / multi action triggers
Recommends keeping these workbooks on Analysis for Office
must_not: Says BPC can be connected via a tunnel connection in the SAC add-in

evals.prompt: Users on tenant https://acme.eu10.analytics.cloud.sap get a disabled Go! button in the SAC Excel add-in. What do we check?
expectations: Explains non-standard domains (anything other than hcs.cloud.sap) need Microsoft 365 admin configuration via Set-OrganizationAddInOverrides with ProductId 8a512e2b-c04e-4c06-9235-11b6cd59f584
Mentions checking Trusted Origins in SAC (System > Administration > App Integration), including manually adding https://*.cloud.microsoft
Mentions clearing the add-in cache for users who loaded it before the configuration
must_not: Lists https://*.excel.cloud.microsoft as the required trusted origin

evals.prompt: Write a VBA macro that refreshes the workbook and then publishes the planning data automatically every morning.
expectations: Uses SAPOFXLA.VBAAPI.RefreshAll and PublishData with the workbook name
Warns that PublishData writes to the public version and asks the user to confirm this behaviour or adds an explicit confirmation step
Notes VBA works only in Excel desktop (Windows/Mac) and async is required on Mac
must_not: Embeds credentials or tokens in the macro

evals.prompt: My SAC add-in table crashes when I add more dimensions; it has about 1.5 million cells.
expectations: Explains the ~4 GB WebView2/WebKit2 memory limit hit around 0.5-1 million cells
Recommends high-volume mode (up to ~10 million cells) and lists its restrictions (no planning, styling, comments, number format tab)
